title: Outcome/evaluation semantic wave
interpreter: running GPT-6 Codex agent; not GPT-5.6 Terra
physical_work_performed: Directly read cited evidence and performed the case analyses below; code only persists and hashes agent-authored results.

findings.claim: 12 evaluations/reviews (7 evaluations, 5 mid-term reviews) are evaluation activity counts, not 12 demonstrated successful interventions.
WVA says it concluded three named meta-reviews in 2024 and uses a standardised monitoring approach. This describes an evidence process; effect sizes remain absent.
49% versus 18% of 24-year-olds not fully engaged in work/study is attributed to external 2020 research; it is background disadvantage evidence, not a Learning for Life outcome.
findings.source_role: external research reproduced in annual report

findings.claim: Bush Heritage separates outputs (implementation), outcomes (threats) and impacts (focal value health); a functioning measurement framework alone is not a positive impact finding.
Angeline's account links agriculture training to improved harvests and income; this is one participant story and does not supply a controlled estimate.
Leaia's household water/toilet changes are described through a story and a one-year follow-up; left-panel organisation impact totals must not be assigned to her household/program.
Caritas summarises four external program evaluations and their positive findings, but underlying reports, methods and sampling are not on this page.
Plan reports resilience successes alongside an evaluation recommendation for more systematic adoption; dropping the recommendation overstates consistency.
Ediegarrup vegetation condition is 45.1/100; next-assessment improvement is expected, not observed. Environmental accounts are explicitly not linked to ACCUs absent eligibility assessment.
Amber's reported improvement is an anonymised On PAR case story; '345 helped' is not evidence every participant achieved Amber's outcomes.

defects: D08: Outcome counts, output counts and background population statistics are easily conflated.
D08b: Inlined multi-column extraction can mix program and organisation counts.
counterexamples: Ediegarrup's ACCU footnote defeats an inference from biodiversity certification to carbon-linked biodiversity verification.
remaining_limitations: Requested Terra interpreter unavailable after session model switch; no second model/API invoked.
Ten pages read; external evaluation methods not available on these pages; Terra-specific evidence unavailable.
persistence: create-exclusive staging file, flushed, Windows no-overwrite atomic rename
